source_order: top-level JSON key order, book list order, chapter list order, verse list order, and source numeric order are authoritative
mutation_claims: omit a book, chapter, or verse
duplicate or reorder a book, chapter, or verse
change verse text or source marker
change a book/chapter/verse identifier or boundary attribute
invent a TEI carrier or source-accountability row
drift source, profile, policy, or manifest bindings
determinism: Two fresh candidate-tool processes must produce identical package member sets and bytes from the same current manifest and source.
